correctness.rationale: Each of eight row distributions starts with 0 bits and must end with 3; pair averaging changes sum entropy by 2JS<=2. Twelve events imply equality each, forcing disjoint supports; reversing a uniform output proves each pair was disjoint equal-size uniform parents, and all rows uniform on power-of-two supports. Conversely 12 such steps saturate total entropy and imply consensus. The exact finite DP counts every and only eligible labelled ordered word once, with 2,528,870,400 words at depth 12; independently memoized suffix count reproduces it; brute force 4-agent rational products reproduce 1/54. No n>=16 claim.
